verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents an official CLI on its own install page. The CLI lets users call Context.dev from the terminal and use JSON responses in scripts or CI, and a probe confirmed the install-cli documentation exists. Missing for 10: detail on CLI commands and which API operations it covers, agent-oriented CLI behaviors, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Call Context.dev from your terminal and use JSON responses in scripts or CI.
